title: COREECOM — Corpus Electrónico del Español Colonial Mexicano
institution: Centro de Lingüística Hispánica 'Juan M. Lope Blanch', Instituto de Investigaciones Filológicas, UNAM (Beatriz Arias Álvarez, coordinator)
region: New Spain, Caribbean (Cuba), Canary Islands and the Iberian Peninsula
notes: The 'Corpus documental' list (checked 2026-10-12) contains 119 documents, all with Periodo between 1500 and 1599 (1500-1524: 11; 1525-1549: 31; 1550-1574: 43; 1575-1599: 34), from AGI, AGN México, AHN, Simancas etc. Intro text announces 16th-18th century coverage but only the 16th century is online. Each document page shows a facsimile reference, the paleographic edition and the critical edition side by side. There is no data download. The site footer gives a last update of 30 August 2019. A member of the CHARTA network. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
